response_text: The kernel is like the core of the operating system. Here, it should run in privileged mode and manage low level operations such as memory, threads, I/O, scheduling, and system calls. The main file, or “user” space, is where the more specialized code for whatever application you are trying to code goes. This code usually does NOT have access to the low-level hardware and instead makes system calls to request services from the kernel. This distinction is important as it improves security (the user program cannot directly access memory or devices), simplifies things by routing each sensitive operation to go through one program (the kernel), and allows users (developers) to focus on application logic instead of how to drive the hardware.\n
